pareta.cp: adj. afflicted with; overcome by; gone on to.

C: pareta：[adj．] afflicted with； overcome by； gone on to．
P: Pareta，[pp．of pareti，more likely para+i than pari+i，although BSk．correspondent is parīta，e．g．śokaparīta Jtm 3194] gone on to，affected with，overcome by （-°），syn．with abhibhūta （e．g．PvA．41，80）．Very frequent in combn with terms of suffering，misadventure and passion，e．g．khudā°，ghamma°，jighacchā°，dukkha°，dosa°，rāga°，soka°，sneha°，Vin．I，5； D．II，36； M．I，13，114，364，460； III，14，92； S．II，110； III，93； IV，28； A．I，147=It．89； A．III，25，96； Sn．449，736，818 （=samohita samannāgata pihita Nd1 149） 1092，1123； J．III，157； Pv．I，86； II，24； Miln．248； PvA．61，93．（Page 439）

parati pr. 3 sg. [ cf S. piparti, pṛṇāti, Wg § 31:19 ], fills; completes or perfects; protects; Cp-a 277, 5 (atha vā ~atī ti paramo, dānādīnaṃ guṇānaṃ pūrako pālako cā ti bodhisatto, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee pūretī ti); Sadd 428, 29 foll. (para pālanapūraṇesu: ~ati paramo t’ imassa rūpāni nara nayane ti dhātussa narati naro ti rūpāni viya, tattha ~atī ti pāleti pūreti vā, suddhakattuvasen’ idaṃ padaṃ vuttaṃ, hetukattuvasena hi pāreti pārayatī ti ādīni rūpāni bhavanti … pāramī ti ~ati pāreti cā ti paramo, dānādīnaṃ guṇānaṃ pālako pūrako ca mahābodhisatto, paramassa idaṃ paramassa bhāvo kammaṃ vā pāramī dānādikiriyā, garūhi pana pūretī ti paramo dānādīnaṃ guṇānaṃ pūrako pālako cā ti vuttaṃ taṃ vīmaṃsitabbaṃ); — caus. pr. 3 sg. pāreti , ~ayati, 1. [ see also Wg § 35:57 ], fills, completes; accomplishes; brings to an end; is able; Ja I 498, 22* (oramāma na ~ema); III 185, 2* (vikkamāmi na ~emi; 185, 4´ : na ~emī ti pāsaṃ pana chindituṃ na sakkomī ti attho) quoted Sadd 560, 3 ; Sadd 429, 1 (para pālanapūraṇesu … ~eti ~ayati); 560, 2 (pāra tīra kammasampattiyaṃ kammasampatti nāma kammassa parisamāpanaṃ niṭṭhāpanaṃ. ~eti ~ayati … pāraṃ); Dhātup 609 a (pāra sāmatthiye) ≠ Dhātum 852; — 2. overspreads; Sp 1046, 21 (nadīpāran ti ettha ~ayatī ti pārā, kiṃ ~ayati nadiṃ, nadiyā pārā nadīpārā, taṃ nadīpāraṃ, nadiṃ ajjhottharamānan ti attho; Sp-ṭ [ Be ] III 272, 23 : ~ayatī ti ajjhottharati, pārā ti sīmāpekkho itthiliṅganiddeso); — see also pūrati.
